SELECT 
	ReceiptCode,
	DATE,
	UserCode, 
	SaleInvCode,
	NetAmt,
	OutstandingAmt,
	CustCode = (SELECT MIN(H.CustCode) FROM InstallmentHeader H WHERE H.SaleInvCode = InstallmentReceipt.SaleInvCode),
	NIC = (SELECT MIN(C.NIC) FROM InstallmentHeader H, Customer C WHERE H.SaleInvCode = InstallmentReceipt.SaleInvCode AND H.CustCode = C.CustCode),
	ItemName = (SELECT I.Name FROM InstallmentHeader H, Item I WHERE H.SaleInvCode = InstallmentReceipt.SaleInvCode AND H.ICode=I.ICode),
	ReceivedUpTill = ISNULL((SELECT H.DownPayment FROM InstallmentHeader H WHERE H.SaleInvCode = InstallmentReceipt.SaleInvCode),0) + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(IR.AmtReceived + IR.Discount) FROM InstallmentReceipt IR WHERE IR.ReceiptCode <= InstallmentReceipt.ReceiptCode AND IR.SaleInvCode = InstallmentReceipt.SaleInvCode), 0),
	InstallmentRowID,
	InstallmentAmount,
	InstallmentDate=GETDATE(),
	InstallmentBalance,
	AmtReceived,
	Discount,
	Fine,
	InstallmentLeft = (SELECT COUNT(D.InstallmentCode) FROM InstallmentHeader H, InstallmentDetail D WHERE H.SaleInvCode = InstallmentReceipt.SaleInvCode AND H.InstallmentCode = D.InstallmentCode AND D.Amount - D.AmtReceived > 0),
	GLVochCode,
	GLVochCodeDisount,
	GLVochCodeFine,
	Remarks
FROM 
	InstallmentReceipt
WHERE
	ReceiptCode = :ai_code
